Delhi Police enters Bangla Sahib Gurudwara, detains protesters

Delhi Police entered the Bangla Sahib Gurudwara and detained protesters who had taken shelter there overnight. The Citzens for Justice and Peace (CJP) organization has urged "Sikh brothers" to join a fight against the government, alleging that police entered the Gurudwara wearing shoes and carrying weapons.
